$comment: Named executable profiles. A record's `benchmark_profile` says what shape its candidate set has; this file says what that shape is, so the validator can check it. Registering a profile here is what makes it checkable — a record declaring a profile that is not registered fails validation rather than passing unchecked, because an unrecognised profile used to mean no structural checks at all, which is the wrong default for a corpus that is meant to be reproducible.

featured-core-2x2x2-v1.description: Two public, two expert and two framework candidates: the Featured v1 pilot standard. Yields 12 unordered cross-source QCCS pairs per complete execution.
featured-core-2x2x2-v1.representation_note: Companion representations of one case family. They must state the same decision question, the same candidate set and the same stipulations, and differ only in scenario detail.
